description: Construct prior-authorization submissions from patient records and payer requirements.
notes: Inlined Kit fallback implements the full contract and is active by design; app runs standalone with zero console errors (Playwright-verified).

notes.note: Prior-auth denials are overwhelmingly paperwork failures, and compiling the packet like code is the right mental model with a clear buyer (practices pay $49/mo). Weakest assumption: payer requirement sets are published, machine-readable, and stable — they're none of those, and keeping up is the real product. Distribution is also brutal: providers are the hardest buyers in software.
Compile packet renders requirement checklist; reset + copy work; zero errors.

notes.change: Added denial-appeal mode (README next-3 #3): denial checkbox + CARC code picker compiles an appeal packet with per-code counter-evidence checklist and a copyable draft appeal letter; fixed Submitted modal action styling (kind->primary).
